style_header: Photorealistic full-body photograph of one person standing, the whole body from head to feet in frame with a little space around, isolated on a perfectly flat pure chroma-key green background (#00FF00) with no shadow on the background, even soft daylight, sharp focus. Kuwait, 1987.
must_not: any text, letters, logos or watermarks

items.prompt: A young Kuwaiti Bedouin man in a white dishdasha and a red-and-white checked shemagh headscarf, cheering with both arms raised high above his head, mouth open shouting, excited.
A young Kuwaiti man in a white dishdasha and white ghutra with black agal, holding a big 1980s shoulder VHS camcorder to his eye, filming toward the left.
A Kuwaiti teenager in a white dishdasha with no headscarf, whistling with two fingers in his mouth, the other hand pumping a fist, excited.
A young Kuwaiti Bedouin man in a beige dishdasha and a red-and-white shemagh wrapped loosely, holding a 1980s compact film camera with the flash, taking a photo, slightly turned to the side.
A young Kuwaiti man in a white dishdasha and white ghutra thrown back over his shoulders, clapping his hands above his head and laughing.
A young Kuwaiti man in a light grey dishdasha and a red-and-white shemagh, pointing excitedly with one arm outstretched and shouting, the other hand on his head in disbelief.
